description: Search Ridgerunner's outdoor gear catalog for hunting, fishing, camping, hiking, kayaking and outdoor apparel and footwear, by keywords and optionally by category or brand. Returns products with brand, price, availability, a product photo and a link to buy on ridgerunner.com. Always show each product's photo (the markdown image line in the result) when presenting results.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'inflatable kayak' or 'tungsten drop shot weights'
